attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Pharmacy (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE; programs accredited by the ASHP/ACPE Pharmacy Technician Accreditation Commission or CCAPP and other sponsors listed in R 338.3662
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE applies to technicians licensed for the entire 2-year period before the end of the license cycle.
rules.alternatives: Waiver request under MCL 333.16205 at least 30 days before the last regular Board meeting before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application certifies compliance; keep records 4 years. Random audit after each renewal period.

topics.who: Pain and symptom management in pharmacy practice
1 hour for each year of the license cycle (not one-time)
One-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.3659)

rules.notes: Two-year license; at least 5 of the 20 hours live/synchronous (ACPE live counts); max 12 hours per 24 hours. CE earned in the 60-day grace period counts.
